div.head: IV As 6.1
div.ab: Si regem uel archiepiscopum requirat uel sanctam Dei ecclesiam, habeat nouem noctes de termino, et querat quicquid querat, non habeat uitam diucius, de quo uere palam erit, nisi capi non possit.
Si regem vel archiepiscopum requirat vel sanctam Dei eccclesiam, habeat novem noctes de termino; et quærat quicquid quærat, non habeat vitam diutius, de quo vere palam erit, nisi capi non possit.

And if he seeks the king, or the archbishop, or a holy church of God, he shall have respite for nine days; but let him seek [whomsoever or] whatever he may, unless he cannot be captured, he shall not be allowed to live longer, if the truth becomes known about him.
div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Old English in H (row 848).
